name: xyz.gullylabs.gamesdk
description: Unity client for Gully Labs services: Gully ID sign-in (OIDC + PKCE), Gully Chain reads (JSON-RPC, ABI), Gully Pay x402 pay-per-call, and Gully Arcade score attestation + on-chain leaderboards. MIT.

samples.description: Start a run, attest the score, build the submitScore calldata and read the leaderboard.
OIDC authorization code + PKCE against id.gullychain.xyz with a loopback redirect (desktop/editor).
Fetch a paid resource: parse the 402, pay on Gully Chain, retry with the payment header.
